description: This file defines the ReportGeneratorService class responsible for generating, retrieving, and manipulating report data within the OrangeHRM system. It manages report headers, data normalization, query building, and saving customized reports, implementing complex logic for report composition and data handling.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorService
classes.description: Main service class for report generation, data retrieval, header management, and report saving within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: isPimReport
methods.description: Checks if a report with the given ID is of type 'PIM_DEFINED'.

methods.name: getHeaderData
methods.description: Retrieves header data for a specific report ID, merging display, composite, and summary fields.

methods.name: getHeaderGroupsForDisplayFields
methods.description: Builds headers grouped in stacks based on display field groups.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Creates a header object with meta information for a report.

methods.name: getNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes report data according to filter parameters, converting DTOs to strings and arrays.

methods.name: getReportDataCount
methods.description: Returns the count of report data entries based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportDataQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds Doctrine query builder with selects, joins, and filters based on report and filter parameters, caching results.

methods.name: getHashKeyForFilterParamObject
methods.description: Generates a md5 hash key for caching query builder results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies sorting and pagination to the query builder based on filter parameters.

methods.name: setJoinsToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds necessary joins to the query builder for specified entity aliases.

methods.name: setJoinToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a specific join to the query builder, respecting alias dependencies.

methods.name: savePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Saves a report with selected display fields, filter criteria, and inclusion type into the database.

methods.name: getInitializedFilterFieldInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a filter field instance of a given class from a selected filter field.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldsByCriteria
methods.description: Creates filter field objects from criteria arrays for report filtering.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldForIncludeEmployee
methods.description: Creates a filter field for include/exclude employee logic based on includeType.

methods.name: modifySelectedFilterFieldValues
methods.description: Modifies filter field values dynamically (e.g., X, Y values) for selected filters.

methods.name: getDisplayFields
methods.description: Retrieves grouped display fields for the report configuration interface.
